title: fix(plugin-audit): an activity summary names a referenced record by a title the writer may read, else by its id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CEjuTu4HVEtNH1742UngyH)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：活动动态摘要里提到被引用的记录时（跟踪的查找字段变更、里程碑句子里的 `{token}`），记录名称按写入者自己的读取范围取得；写入者读不到该记录或其名称字段时，摘要写记录 id。
- 为什么改：加固规则——活动摘要只用写入者本人可读的名称来指称被引用记录，否则用 id；与同一活动行的记录标签用同一读取范围。
- 风险与回滚：只影响此后写入的活动行，已写入的行不变；有权读取的写入者和系统写入的摘要与之前相同；读取次数不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`（两个摘要分支调用 `resolveLookupTitles` 的两处，以及该函数 "Whose read it is" 一节）；`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-title-writer-scope.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/activity-summary-title-writer-scope.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、11 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Hardening rule: **an activity summary names a referenced record by a title the writer may read, else by its id.**

`sys_activity.summary` names a referenced record in two branches: the tracked-change diff (`Vault: A → B`) and a fired milestone's `{token}` (`Escalated to {vault}`). Both take the title from `resolveLookupTitles` in `audit-writers.ts`. Both now hand it the hook's own `api`, the writer's scope. The row's record label already reads there, so every title an activity row writes follows one rule.

- A record the writer may not read keeps its stored id: the object refuses the writer, or the writer's row scope leaves the record out.
- A record the writer may read without its title column keeps its stored id.
- The rule holds per id. One change can title the side the writer may read and keep the id of the side it may not.
- A writer who may read the target, and every system write, gets the same summary as before.
- No read is added. It is still one `id: { $in }` read per distinct target object, and only when a tracked reference moved or a fired milestone names one.

The resolver's docblock now states the rule for every caller. Rows already written keep the summary they were written with.

## Tests

New file `src/activity-summary-title-writer-scope.test.ts` (11 cases) runs a bare engine with the real `installAuditWriters`. The restrictions are engine middleware on the target object: a refused read, a row left out by row scope, and a row served without its title column. For each branch it pins the three restricted writers, a writer who may read and a system write. The tracked branch also pins the per-id case. The cases assert the stored sentence and the stored summary code that the read side composes from.

<details><summary>Red first: the new file against the base source</summary>

At `origin/main` `bf76922925`, before the fix:

```
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  7 failed | 4 passed (11)
```

The 4 that pass are the controls (a writer who may read, and a system write, in each branch).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD</summary>

| Mutation | Red |
|---|---|
| M1: the tracked-change branch's call takes its base-source argument again | 4 (the three restricted writers and the per-id case) |
| M2: the milestone branch's call takes its base-source argument again | 3 (the three restricted writers) |

Each logged `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0` and `ok restored: blob == HEAD (b8e96db505a1) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck at 7c093c01 (after merging origin/main)</summary>

Closure rebuilt after the merge (`turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/plugin-audit...`, 16/16 tasks), `@objectstack/spec check:generated` reports all 14 generated artifacts up to date. Under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck
 Test Files  100 passed (100)
      Tests  1665 passed (1665)
check:test-typecheck: OK — @objectstack/plugin-audit's test layer compiles
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope.** Only the two summary branches change. The record label already read its title in the writer's scope.
- **`referenceNameVisible`.** A lookup that declares it follows the same rule in the summary as in the record label. Whether that key should widen what activity rows name is a question raised with the owning seat. This PR does not decide it.
- **Already-written rows** keep the summary they were written with. Snapshots are not rewritten.
- **Test placement.** The summary branches have no shared harness file (each audit suite carries its own), so the pins are a new file named for the rule.

## Verification

Local gate subset: the `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` list derived at `7c093c01` (72 commands). 70 answered exit 0, one of them after its pinned fixture commit was fetched into this shallow clone. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` refused locally (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's build output), and so did `check:i18n` (it needs the CLI build closure). Both are NOT MEASURED here. CI runs both in `Lint & Repo Gates`, and CI runs the full farm.
